name: SerpX AI SEO Assistant
author: SerpX

sections.description:
SerpX AI SEO Assistant helps WordPress users improve content optimization directly inside the WordPress editor.

The plugin connects your WordPress site to SerpX and provides AI-powered SEO analysis, SEO scoring, and meta title and description suggestions for posts and pages.

Features

  • AI-powered content analysis
  • SEO score and optimization checks
  • Meta title generation
  • Meta description generation
  • Word count analysis
  • Keyword density analysis
  • Heading structure checks
  • Yoast SEO compatibility
  • Rank Math compatibility
  • All in One SEO compatibility
  • Classic Editor support
  • Gutenberg support
  • Credit-based AI generation

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • A SerpX account (sign up at serpx.ai)

External Services

This plugin connects to the SerpX API to analyze content and generate SEO suggestions.

When you use the analysis or generation features, the plugin may send the following data to SerpX:

  • Post title
  • Post content
  • Focus keyword
  • Site URL

This data is used only to generate SEO analysis and meta suggestions.

  • Service URL: https://serpx.ai
  • Privacy Policy: https://serpx.ai/privacy-policy
  • Terms: https://serpx.ai/terms-and-conditions
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/serpx-ai-seo-assistant directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open SerpX SEO from the WordPress admin sidebar.
  4. Paste your SerpX API key.
  5. Test the connection.
  6. Open a post or page and start using the SerpX AI SEO Assistant panel.
sections.faq:
Where can I get my API key?

You can generate your API key from your SerpX account dashboard.

Does this plugin work with Yoast SEO?

Yes. Generated SEO titles and meta descriptions can sync with Yoast SEO fields.

Does this plugin support Rank Math?

Yes. Rank Math SEO title and description fields are supported.

Does this plugin support All in One SEO?

Yes. All in One SEO title and description fields are supported.

Does it work with Gutenberg?

Yes. The plugin supports Gutenberg and the Classic Editor.

Does this plugin use an external API?

Yes. SerpX AI SEO Assistant connects to the SerpX API to analyze content and generate SEO suggestions.
